newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's says China losses rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's says China losses rises.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said losses from its Chinese brewing business widened to A$17 million in the year to June 30, 1996 from A$12 million a year earlier.
"The situation in China remains challenging wth significant investment in sales, distribution and marketing," Foster's said in a statement accompanying its 1995/96 annual results.
"This (China) investment will continue in the current financial year as a sales and distribution network is developed in major cities," Foster's said.
Foster's earlier reported a two percent rise in net profit to A$293.3 million for the 1995/96 year.
